breakdown.description: Claiming to run a 2D simulation but using wall (noSlip) boundary conditions on front/back faces instead of empty.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a 2D simulation extruded by one cell requires 'empty' boundary conditions on the front and back faces, not 'wall' (noSlip) conditions. The generated specification explicitly states to use the 'empty' type and applies this condition consistently across all relevant physics files (U, T, p, p_rgh, k, epsilon, etc.), directly matching the correction in the ground truth.
